To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
discriminative visual word learning and APC descriptors can significantly improve the performance of 3D human body pose estimation from a single image, while also being fast and efficient.

(a) discriminative visual words can be learned in a supervised manner, (b) the appearance and position context local descriptor can be used for 3D pose estimation, and (c) discriminative visual word learning and APC local descriptor extraction can be combined for 3D joint pose estimation.
We propose to use discriminative visual words to improve the pose estimation accuracy.

we propose a novel approach for 3D pose estimation from single images, with the following advantages: discriminative learning of visual features, appearance and position context descriptor, joint learning of features and pose regressors, and fast inference.
